conversations_type_check.name: conversations_type_check
conversations_type_check.value: ("conversations"."type" = 'dm' and "conversations"."dm_key" is not null and "conversations"."clan_id" is null and "conversations"."event_id" is null) or ("conversations"."type" = 'clan' and "conversations"."clan_id" is not null and "conversations"."dm_key" is null and "conversations"."event_id" is null) or ("conversations"."type" = 'event' and "conversations"."event_id" is not null and "conversations"."dm_key" is null and "conversations"."clan_id" is null)

messages_type_check.name: messages_type_check
messages_type_check.value: ("messages"."type" = 'user' and "messages"."sender_id" is not null) or ("messages"."type" = 'system' and "messages"."system_key" is not null)

spots_difficulty_check.name: spots_difficulty_check
spots_difficulty_check.value: ("spots"."type" = 'trail' and "spots"."difficulty" between 1 and 5) or ("spots"."type" = 'camp' and "spots"."difficulty" is null)
